text:
Luca Moreno: Quick question - partner got a job in Berlin and we'll be relocating right after our parental leave. What do I need to do for benefits/tax withholdings, visa docs, and whether leave can be taken while relocating internationally? Also need a quick template for equipment handoff if we ship laptop to a contractor.

Hannah (People Ops): Congrats Luca! Important points: parental leave eligibility continues if you remain employed by Redwood and on our payroll, but cross-border employment can affect benefits. If you move to Germany while on leave we need to know whether you'll remain on US payroll or switch to the local entity. Please fill out the international-relocation questionnaire here: https://intranet.redwood.com/people-ops/intl-relocate (Doc).

Hannah (People Ops): Visa & immigration: we don't sponsor family visas automatically; check with Global Mobility. Upload your partner's job offer and intended move date and we'll loop in Global Mobility and Legal.

GlobalHR-bot: Reminder: benefits eligibility check initiated. Please upload proof of address in new country within 10 days after relocation. Expect an email from global-hr@redwood.com.

Raj (Manager): For coverage, we can do a 3-week staggered handoff so Luca can finish the last sprint remotely. Luca, do you prefer a contractor or internal temp?

Luca Moreno: Contractor preferred for 12 weeks. Can IT ship the laptop to our Berlin address? Also, will my health coverage continue if I'm off payroll during the transition?

IT-ops: We can ship to Berlin if you sign the international asset transfer form. We'll need destination address and customs contact. Add "IT-asset" in the form. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/it/asset-transfer.

Hannah (People Ops): Health coverage: if you remain on Redwood payroll and maintain benefits enrollment, coverage continues. If you switch to a local entity or become contractor, coverage may change. We will run a benefits-impact memo once you confirm payroll status. File the parental leave form now and note the relocation intention so we can coordinate the timing.

Hannah (People Ops): Equipment handoff template (copy/paste):
```
Hi @team,
I'll be on parental leave from START_DATE to END_DATE and relocating to Berlin shortly after. Coverage during my leave: Raj will be primary contact (raj@redwood.com). Contractor NAME will cover day-to-day tasks and will be issued a company laptop shipped to ADDRESS. Runbooks & credentials: <link>. I will do staggered handoff during the three weeks prior to START_DATE.
Thanks, Luca
```

Luca Moreno: Thanks everyone. I'll upload relocation & visa docs tonight and choose contractor details by EOD tomorrow. Appreciated :airplane: :heart:
